rules.when: The selection contains only observed, in-radius candidates with a supported source path.
Targets missing identity/area/HARD facts of an observed candidate with a supported path.
Uses a materially different supported source or query; preserves every explicit condition.

At least 3 in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates are checkable in this context (there are 8: Sumi Sushi Shibuya, Sushi Tatsu Shibuya, Shibuya Sushi Jinnan, Sushi kazumasa, Sushi Matsumoto Shibuya, Sushi Inase, Sushi Rizaki, Naminoue shibuya), so every selected candidate must be in-radius and DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE. Selecting a NAME_RESOLUTION candidate is acceptable only when fewer than 3 in-radius DIRECT candidates are checkable.
Targets in-radius DIRECT_SOURCE_PAGE candidates whose HARD fact (omakase) is not yet verified.

manualConditionPolicy: Uncompiled or semantic-search conditions remain NOT_EVALUATED, never action-type-only PASS.
